summary: Ukraine replaced Commander-in-Chief Syrsky with Drapatiy and appointed Skibiuk as Chief of General Staff amid ongoing Russian advances near Kharkiv and multi-axis drone strikes across Ukraine. Russian forces claim control of Artelnoye and Blagovatnoye while conducting ballistic missile threats from Crimea and northeast directions. Ukrainian drones struck Russian logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol regions and an oil depot in Armavir.
key_points: Mikhail Drapatiy replaced Aleksandr Syrsky as Commander-in-Chief of Ukrainian Armed Forces; Major General Igor Skibiuk appointed Chief of General Staff. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31816)
Russian MoD claims control over Artelnoye in Kharkiv region and Blagovatnoye in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31833)
Ukrainian drones attacked Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol regions and oil depot in Armavir. (Source: @UkraineNow/82826)
Ballistic missile threat from northeast; Iskander-M launch threat from occupied Crimea reported. (Source: @kpszsu/69762)
Russian air defense shot down 80 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions in one day. (Source: @tass_agency/386550)
FPV drone attack on gas station in Kharkiv injured five workers. (Source: @UkraineNow/82837)
Fighting in Sumy direction: Russian 'North' Group engages Ukrainian troops in multiple villages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Zelensky traveling to US for Senator Graham funeral; possible Trump meeting delays defense minister appointment. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31841)

sections.executive_summary: Ukraine replaced Commander-in-Chief Syrsky with Drapatiy and appointed Skibiuk as Chief of General Staff amid ongoing Russian advances near Kharkiv and multi-axis drone strikes across Ukraine. Russian forces claim control of Artelnoye and Blagovatnoye while conducting ballistic missile threats from Crimea and northeast directions. Ukrainian drones struck Russian logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol regions and an oil depot in Armavir.

points: President Zelensky appointed Mikhail Drapatiy as Commander-in-Chief replacing Aleksandr Syrsky and named Major General Igor Skibiuk as Chief of General Staff, though Drapatiy's appointment faces legal controversy due to absence of a confirmed defense minister. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31816, @ukr_leaks_eng/31830, @ukr_leaks_eng/31831)

Zelensky ranks fourth in public trust at 70% for former Commander-in-Chief Zaluzhny according to Rating Group survey, while over half of Ukrainians consider mobilization the country's main problem per Institute of Sociology director. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31834, @ukr_leaks_eng/31828)

Demographic crisis deepens: mortality exceeds births fourfold with 259,853 deaths versus 73,292 births in first half of 2026; worst in frontline Donetsk region with 19 deaths per newborn. (Source: @UkraineNow/82838, @UkraineNow/82843)

Dnipropetrovsk region reduces fuel reserves at gas stations to minimize losses from potential attacks; Kherson police warn drivers against gathering at fuel stations due to strike threats. (Source: @UkraineNow/82836, @UkraineNow/82831)
Embezzlement case in Mykolaiv region: company director received 68 million hryvnias for anti-drone structures at energy facility but failed to complete work. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31843)

Zelensky traveling to United States for Senator Graham funeral with possible Trump meeting; no personnel decisions including defense minister expected during this period. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31841)
Russian Ministry of Defense claims control over Artelnoye in Kharkiv region and Blagovatnoye in Zaporizhzhia region following offensive operations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31833)
Russian air defense destroyed 80 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions in single day according to MoD statement. (Source: @tass_agency/386550)
DNR head Denis Pushilin claims EU membership promises are manipulation tool to create false motivation for Ukrainians. (Source: @tass_agency/386576)
Russian officials discuss debt relief for citizens facing job loss or serious illness; Kamaz plans fully autonomous truck operation by 2028. (Source: @tass_agency/386580, @tass_agency/386583)
FPV drone attacks in Belgorod region killed two civilians and injured multiple others across several districts including Shebekino, Krasnoyaruzhsky, and Belgorod city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Equipment at Belgorod Reservoir hydraulic complex damaged by Ukrainian fire causing water release; deliberate targeting of dam continues. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)

Russian 127th Motorized Rifle Regiment of 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division drove Ukrainian 113th Territorial Defense Battalion from Volokhovskoye in Volchansky district, creating conditions to encircle Bely Kolodez logistics hub. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Russian forces claim capture of Artelnoye in Kharkiv region and Blagovatnoye in Zaporizhzhia region per MoD report. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31833)
KAB guided bomb strikes reported on eastern Dnipropetrovsk region and border of Zaporizhzhia-Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @kpszsu/69769, @kpszsu/69771)
Civilian casualties in DPR: two killed and three injured from Ukrainian UAV attacks on road from Maly Kermenchik to Stepnoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Jet-powered UAVs targeting eastern Dnipropetrovsk region from multiple directions. (Source: @kpszsu/69774, @kpszsu/69743)

Sumy direction: Russian 'North' Group of Forces engaged in firefights with Ukrainian troops in Ulanovo, Malaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, and forest areas south of Ivolzhan. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Multiple UAV incursions in Sumy region: drones near Putivl, Buryn, Shalyhine, Glukhiv from northern and northeastern directions. (Source: @kpszsu/69765, @kpszsu/69768, @kpszsu/69774)
Chernihiv region: UAVs moving toward Ichniya; five Shahed drones from Sumy region toward Nizhyn district. (Source: @kpszsu/69774, @mon1tor_ua/69302)
Ballistic missile threat from northeast reported; Iskander-M launch threat from occupied Crimea. (Source: @kpszsu/69762, @mon1tor_ua/69304)
Jet-powered UAVs in Poltava region near Orzhytsia heading toward Drabiv and Kremenchuk/Hradizsk. (Source: @eRadarrua/102164)
Odesa region: three guided UAVs from sea toward Odesa region; two Shahed drones targeting Odesa port. (Source: @eRadarrua/102198, @mon1tor_ua/69300)
Mykolaiv region: UAVs moving toward Dmytrivka from southeast; two UAVs from Bashtanka westward. (Source: @kpszsu/69739, @eRadarrua/102194)
Russian strikes on Odesa, Chornomorsk, and Mykolaiv ports as well as a ship and two cargo ships continued overnight. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Kirovohrad region: UAV reconnaissance activity; UAV toward Malaya Vyska from north. (Source: @eRadarrua/102171, @eRadarrua/102194)
Zaporizhzhia region: UAV near Novoslobidka; KAB strikes on Zaporizhzhia-Dnipropetrovsk border. (Source: @eRadarrua/102194, @kpszsu/69769)

Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol regions and oil depot in Armavir causing large fire; centers used for supplying drone components and dual-use goods to Russian army. (Source: @UkraineNow/82826)

Massive UAV activity across Ukraine: Shahed drones, jet-powered UAVs, and guided UAVs reported in Kharkiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, Odesa regions. (Source: @kpszsu/69737, @kpszsu/69746, @kpszsu/69759, @kpszsu/69770, @kpszsu/69742, @kpszsu/69765, @kpszsu/69768, @kpszsu/69774, @mon1tor_ua/69302, @mon1tor_ua/69306, @eRadarrua/102155, @eRadarrua/102164, @eRadarrua/102194, @eRadarrua/102198, @eRadarrua/102201)
FPV drone attack on gas station in Kharkiv's Nemyshlyansky district destroyed fuel column and injured five station workers. (Source: @UkraineNow/82837)

Russian air defense shot down 80 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions in one day; air defense active in Voronezh region, Crimea including southern part, and Leningrad region where 6 UAVs downed. (Source: @tass_agency/386550, @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)
Ballistic missile threat from northeast; Iskander-M launch threat from occupied Crimea. (Source: @kpszsu/69762, @mon1tor_ua/69304)

KAB guided bomb strikes on multiple fronts: eastern Dnipropetrovsk, northern Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia-Dnipropetrovsk border, Donetsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/69774, @kpszsu/69769, @kpszsu/69771, @kpszsu/69743)

Ballistic missile threats from northeast and Iskander-M from Crimea; massive multi-region UAV incursions across Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/69762, @mon1tor_ua/69304, @kpszsu/69737, @kpszsu/69746, @kpszsu/69759, @kpszsu/69770)
FPV drone attack on Kharkiv gas station kills five workers; Belgorod region suffers multiple FPV attacks with civilian casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/82837, @ukr_leaks_eng/31824)

sections.threat_assessment: Ukraine's leadership transition creates command uncertainty while Russian forces exploit the moment with coordinated advances near Kharkiv and persistent missile-drone campaigns. The capture of Volokhovskoye threatens to isolate the key Bely Kolodez logistics hub, potentially collapsing Ukrainian supply lines in the sector. Simultaneous ballistic threats from Crimea and northeast axes indicate Russian capacity for strategic strikes against critical infrastructure. Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian logistics demonstrate growing asymmetric capability but risk escalation. The demographic crisis and mobilization discontent undermine long-term force generation.
sections.regional_response: Azerbaijan positions itself as alternative energy supplier to Europe citing Russian supply disruptions and Middle East instability. EU considers allowing Greek transit of Russian LNG for 12 months, indicating sanctions fragmentation. DNR leadership dismisses EU integration promises as manipulation. Russian domestic measures include debt relief for distressed citizens and autonomous vehicle development, suggesting long-term war economy preparation. Regional actors hedge against prolonged conflict and shifting energy geopolitics.
sections.intelligence_notes: The legal ambiguity of Drapatiy's appointment without a confirmed defense minister may create command paralysis during critical defensive operations. Russian 'North' Group's systematic clearance of Sumy border villages suggests preparation for deeper incursion or buffer zone creation. Wildberries targeting reveals Ukrainian intelligence on Russian military supply chains using civilian e-commerce infrastructure. Fuel reserve reductions at Ukrainian gas stations indicate anticipation of sustained energy infrastructure attacks. Embezzlement in anti-drone construction exposes corruption vulnerabilities in critical defense projects.
